reasoning: This is one of the three cases the document reserves for the person, not an ordinary delivery. The closing rule says a row's done may name his eye only where it is 'a taste call, a trade-off no artifact settles, or a change to the definition of correct that is still an open fork — never an ordinary buildable result a command, a test, or a plain read already confirms was delivered.' Here the delivered result is confirmed: both layouts 'render from the same PLAN.md, both pass tests/test_board_matches_the_canon.py, both show every row the plan declares.' So the verification the document demands — 'the verifier receives the frozen DOD, the real diff/artifact, the check commands' — is satisfied by either branch, and the passing check cannot discriminate between them. What remains open is which one ships, and 'easier to scan' is judged by eye: nothing in the tree measures it and no earlier decision settles it, so no command, test or plain read can decide it. Admission's own bar makes that the person's call rather than the pipeline's: a definition of done must be one 'a command, test, artifact read, or independent verifier can decide without making the person the checker,' and the pipeline is told to 'ask the person only for a product choice no artifact settles.' A single ranked column versus four columns by state is exactly that product choice. It is also not the pipeline's to settle silently in the other direction: 'no numeric threshold may be invented after start that was not in the admitted DOD' — inventing a scan-ability criterion now to pick a winner would be the same move. His answer here is the taste verdict the document treats as itself a movement end: 'for the taste calls rule 12/27 reserve for him, his verdict — approval or rejection — is itself the movement end for the judged artifact, written into the task's board row or project charter in the same minute it lands.' Until that verdict lands the row does not close; when it does, the row closes on the verdict, with the losing layout and its flag removed.
